title: People, roles and related upstream work
summary: Architecture and direction: Tom Dyer (hc3). Coding: ChatGPT sessions (object features, built-ins) and Claude sessions (threading, operators, external libraries, numeric, signal/raise, library support, performance, security managers). Josep Maria Blasco (EPBCN) tests rx2cpp on his Rexx Parser and grok.rex and maintains oorexxpython; his RexxCallback implementation answers ooRexx feature request #881 (Rony G. Flatscher), and rx2cpp will test his upload rather than write its own. A compiled program has no interpreter labels, so a callback naming a label of compiled code will need a label table in the generated code, to be designed once his API is in. BSF4ooRexx (Rony G. Flatscher) and oorexxpython are tested from compiled code (native/test_bsf.sh, native/test_python.sh).
invariants: Credit the architecture to Tom Dyer and the coding to the model or person who did it in every update.
Do not reimplement work another contributor has in progress upstream (FR #881).

provenance.claim: BSF4ooRexx and oorexxpython from compiled code.
